correctness.rationale: The exact hidden-state model yields moments A,B,C,D. V=C-A²=ψ(1−ψ)θ²(p−f)²>0, L=(D−AB)/V=p+f and LA−B=pf, giving the strictly ordered roots f,p. T=A−f then recovers ψ=T²/(V+T²) and θ=T/[ψ(p−f)]. Exchangeability plus equal marginal constraints reconstruct the whole eight-cell law. All partitions with fewer than three assays or three assays not split 2+1 remain continuously confounded. The direct determinant equals −ψ²(1−ψ)θ⁴(p−f)⁶. The standalone exact-rational enumeration passed 12,004 assertions; it is supplementary to the infinite-domain analytical proof.

The new result proves both sharp minimality among all three-test partitions and a global rational/square-root inverse for the constrained model, and explicitly does not claim identification of the 2017 unrestricted model.

originality.rationale: Checked two-stage ecological occupancy with imperfect assays, false-positive occupancy baselines, and related published mathematical claims. An unrestricted five-parameter two-stage model already exists (Guillera-Arroita et al. 2017), but its label ambiguity and calibration examples do not establish the new minimal restricted zero-upstream-contamination 2+1 design, exact four-moment inverse, and feasible three-bit-law criterion. Indirect implications, generic latent-mixture identification literature and inaccessible older source text remain explicit priority risks.
residual_risks: The full Royle–Link (2006) journal body was not successfully inspected; abstract and later sources do not rule out all latent-class special cases.
General finite-mixture and grouped-observation identifiability theory might contain an equivalent result under different terminology.

The 2017 unrestricted likelihood is a related stronger modelling framework; the present novelty is the minimum asymmetric design and exact inverse under additional assumptions, not the hierarchy itself.

value.rationale: The exact minimum of two independent primary samples and three assay outcomes determines a practical lower boundary on joint identification of site occupancy, primary availability, true detection, and false assay detection. The symmetry-breaking formula and full-law criterion explain what extra replication reveals and where identification collapses. The Jacobian quantifies meaningful conditioning deterioration. These are structural survey-design statements for ecologically motivated nested measurements, not a trivial arithmetic specialization, and no field calibration or finite-sample precision is claimed.
